apikit:config.name: shipmentTrackingApiConfig
apikit:config.doc:name: APIkit Config
apikit:config.doc:description: APIkit router configuration bound to the OAS 3.0 spec. Handles request validation, routing, and CORS headers.

flow.name: shipment-tracking-api-main
flow.doc:name: Shipment Tracking API — Main
flow.doc:description: Entry point for all inbound requests. Listens on /api/v1/* and delegates routing and OAS validation to the APIkit router.

http:listener.doc:name: HTTP Listener /api/v1/*
http:listener.doc:description: Listens for all HTTP requests to the /api/v1 base path on the port configured in global-configs.xml.

apikit:router.doc:name: APIkit Router
apikit:router.doc:description: Validates the inbound request against the OAS spec and routes to the matching implementation flow.

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Bad Request
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Returns 400 when the request body or parameters fail OAS schema validation.

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 400 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds a normalised 400 ErrorResponse with the APIkit validation message.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: error.description, correlationId: correlationId }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Not Found
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Returns 404 when the requested path does not exist in the OAS spec.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "The requested resource does not exist.", correlationId: correlationId }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Method Not Allowed
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Returns 405 when the HTTP method is not defined for the path in the OAS spec.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", message: "HTTP method not allowed for this resource.", correlationId: correlationId }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Unsupported Media Type
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Returns 415 when the Content-Type is not supported by the spec.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE", message: "Content-Type not supported.", correlationId: correlationId }

flow.name: get:\health:shipmentTrackingApiConfig
flow.doc:name: GET /health
flow.doc:description: Returns API health status. No upstream calls needed — this is a lightweight liveness check.

logger.doc:name: Log Health Request
logger.doc:description: Logs every health check request at DEBUG level to avoid polluting INFO logs.

ee:transform.doc:name: Build Health Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Returns a static UP response. Replace with dynamic health aggregation when implementing business logic.

flow.name: get:\shipments\{trackingNumber}:shipmentTrackingApiConfig
flow.doc:name: GET /shipments/{trackingNumber}
flow.doc:description: Tracks a shipment. Reads the trackingNumber path param and optional carrier query param, selects the correct carrier adapter sub-flow, and returns a normalised ShipmentTracking response.

logger.doc:name: Log Track Request
logger.doc:description: Logs every inbound tracking request including the tracking number and carrier hint.

set-variable.doc:name: Set trackingNumber
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the path parameter trackingNumber in a flow variable for use by adapter sub-flows.

set-variable.doc:name: Set carrier
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the optional carrier query parameter. Null triggers auto-detection logic (to be implemented).

logger.message: [GET /shipments] Business logic not yet implemented. Returning 501 stub response.
logger.doc:name: Log Not Implemented
logger.doc:description: Temporary warning log until the carrier routing and adapter sub-flows are implemented.

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 501 Stub Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Temporary 501 Not Implemented stub. Remove when business logic is wired in.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "NOT_IMPLEMENTED", message: "Tracking logic is not yet implemented. This is a scaffold placeholder.", correlationId: correlationId }
